## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change, and what problem or need does it address? -->

Closes #<!-- issue number, if any -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new feature
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `improvement`: refactor or behaviour tweak
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `chore`: project files or tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] The change addresses one clearly defined problem or need, with no unrelated edits.
- [ ] Commit messages follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages).
- [ ] Code follows the [project conventions](../docs/reference/conventions.md) and the
      [style guide](../.agents/architecture/style-guide.md).
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed logic, and the full GUT suite passes.
- [ ] The demo (`demo/content/levels/main.tscn`) runs and the affected parts work.
- [ ] Documentation updated in the same PR (`docs/` for user-facing behaviour, `.agents/` for
      architecture and conventions).
- [ ] Architectural changes were discussed in an issue first, if they are substantial.
